exact_statement: For every binary law on n>=2 coordinates with d_i=P(S_i=1) and sum d_i>0, define B_A=H(S_A|S_Ac), beta_A=sum_(i in A) E min(P(S_i=1|S_Ac),P(S_i=0|S_Ac)), kappa=2/ln2 and U_A=B_A+kappa beta_A. Then B_A>=sum_A B_i, beta_A>=sum_A beta_i and min_(nonempty proper A,I_A>0)U_A/I_A=min_(i:d_i>0)U_i/d_i. The analogous equality holds for Ucap_A=B_A+min(|A|,kappa beta_A), with singleton cost B_i+min(1,kappa beta_i). For Boolean uniform-cube physical restrictions L_A=B_A+J_A<=U_A; the optimized recentering certificate therefore cannot gain from block size. On the exact frozen list of 1150 saved NAND shapes at n=6..9, 265 pass U_A<=R(f)I_A and 885 fail every proper block; 479 of the failures have a directly verified proper block with L_A<R(f)I_A. All seven frozen seed/hybrid controls fail the U certificate, four despite direct strict actual descent. For F_m=product_j (-1)^(x_j y_j), m>=2, R=2, U_A/I_A=2+kappa and Ucap_A/I_A=4 for every proper block, whereas L_A=2 times the number of touched pairs and querying one full pair attains L_A/I_A=2. All physical children have ratio<=2. Products of a two-bit quadratic factor with a three-bit point defect, and their disjoint tensor powers, similarly fail every U certificate at the source ratio while admitting strict actual full-factor descent. No larger-fixed-K or high-threshold minimal-critical impossibility, FEI bound or unbounded Boolean H/I family is claimed.
